svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint tracking API endpoints: file tree of 13 entries (3 folders, 10 files), 2 levels. The 10 endpoints of the Parcelpoint tracking API by tag (shipments, tracking, and webhooks), imported from its OpenAPI document.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-orjb0b0m9h, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint tracking API endpoints
svg.desc: Parcelpoint tracking API endpoints: file tree of 13 entries (3 folders, 10 files), 2 levels. The 10 endpoints of the Parcelpoint tracking API by tag (shipments, tracking, and webhooks), imported from its OpenAPI document. - shipments/ (folder, 5 entries): Shipments and their labels - shipments/GET /shipments: List shipments - shipments/POST /shipments: Create a shipment - shipments/GET /shipments/{id}: Get a shipment - shipments/DELETE /shipments/{id}: Cancel a shipment - shipments/GET /shipments/{id}/label: Download the label PDF - tracking/ (folder, 3 entries): Where a parcel is - tracking/GET /parcels/{code}: Track a parcel - tracking/GET /parcels/{code}/events: List a parcel's events - tracking/POST /carrier-events: Receive an event from a carrier - webhooks/ (folder, 2 entries): Events sent to a merchant - webhooks/GET /webhooks: List webhooks - webhooks/POST /webhooks: Add a webhook

g.text: Receive an event from a carrier
